name: Staple Colorizer
description: Assigns an HSL color palette to all staple strands. Palette style, hue, saturation, and lightness are configurable.

parameters.label: Palette style
parameters.description: How hues are distributed across helices.

parameters.label: Base hue (°)
parameters.description: Starting hue in degrees. Acts as the single hue when palette is 'Uniform'.

parameters.label: Saturation (%)
parameters.description: HSL saturation of the generated colors.

parameters.label: Lightness (%)
parameters.description: HSL lightness of the generated colors.

parameters.label: Colorize scaffold
parameters.description: Also set a color on scaffold 5' ends (muted version of base hue).
